title: Newsdeck Workflows Event
description: Schema for POST /api/workflows. Requires columnId and item and/or items. If both item and items are present, items takes precedence. Unknown top-level fields are ignored by the server.

columnId.description: UUID for the target column. Found in the column settings in the UI.

item.description: Single news item (recommended format). Ignored if items is also present.

items.description: Array of news items (batch format). Same structure as item. Takes precedence over item if both are present.

extra.description: Extra fields applied to all items in the request. Merged into each item's extra object; on key collision the request-level value wins.

title.description: Headline. The only required field. Must be non-empty.

id.description: Source's own ID (optional, not unique). Used for deduplication within a column: a new item with the same id replaces the previous one in the column view.

flowId.description: Optional workflow/flow identifier from the sending system. Stored on the item, not used for routing.

source.description: Source name, e.g. Trafikverket, Polisen, SOS Alarm. Default: workflows. If it starts with http and no url is given, it is also used as the item URL.

url.description: Link to source or article. Also accepted as uppercase URL (URL takes precedence if both are present).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, e.g. 2026-03-23T10:30:00Z. Invalid or missing values fall back to server time.

newsValue.description: News value 1-5. 5 = highest priority (red ribbon). Default: 3. Out-of-range values are not rejected; the server clamps to 0-5.

category.description: Event category, e.g. trafikolycka, brand, vagarbete.

severity.description: Severity level - free text string, e.g. Allvarlig. Can be null.

location.description: Geographic information. Stored as-is in JSONB (coordinates are normalized).

name.description: Free-text place name, e.g. E4 vid Rotebro.

county.description: County name in free text, e.g. Stockholms lan.

municipality.description: Municipality name in free text, e.g. Stockholm.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, exactly 2 uppercase letters, e.g. SE.

regionCode.description: SCB county code, exactly 2 digits, e.g. 01 for Stockholm, 24 for Vasterbotten.

municipalityCode.description: SCB municipality code, exactly 4 digits, e.g. 0180 for Stockholm.

coordinates.description: Coordinates as [lat, lon] number array, a comma-separated string ('64.3, 21.1'), a single-element array with such a string, or a {latitude, longitude}/{lat, lng} object. Normalized to a [lat, lon] array on ingestion; unparseable values are dropped.

extra.description: Optional extra fields for this item. Request-level extra is merged on top of this object.
